stem: At Solace Travel, API demand swings hourly and each web node is stateless behind a load balancer.

choices.text: Increase one instance from m6i.large to m6i.4xlarge
Use horizontal Auto Scaling driven by target tracking metrics
Hibernate each node during traffic spikes
Pin all traffic to one Availability Zone

rationale: Stateless web tiers with variable demand align well with horizontal Auto Scaling driven by target tracking. Vertical-only growth on a single node increases failure impact and reduces elasticity granularity. Hibernation is for preserving RAM state during stop/start windows, not spike handling. Constraining traffic to one AZ conflicts with resilient elastic scaling patterns.
